description: This Java source file defines the 'DatatableReportingProcessService' class, which extends 'AbstractReportingProcessService'. It handles processing report requests for data tables, charts, and SMS, supporting various export modes via 'DatatableReportExportService' implementations. The class is annotated as a Spring @Service and a custom @ReportService annotation, indicating its role in reporting functionalities within the system.

classes.name: DatatableReportingProcessService
classes.description: Main service class handling report processing logic, including report exporting and response building.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming report requests, determines export mode, invokes the appropriate export service, and constructs the HTTP response.

methods.name: getAvailableExportTargets
methods.description: Returns a list of available export target types supported by the registered export services.
